title: Really love Routinery
body: I haven’t found any other app quite like Routinery. I love the timers, that the app stays open so you can see the time counting down on a routine, I find it helps not loose track of time, or at least the time crunch gives motivation to focus and work faster. I love that you can even time seconds and the tasks can easily be rearranged while the routine is going on (temporarily or permanently), incase I don’t want to follow the tasks in the same order or even skip a task.
author: j376___
